inference.new: CREPE-full and PENN whole-file Viterbi on ft/SW,4 sequential processes; existing pYIN reused

stage1.same_recipe: C3 .2/.05/128ms; short flux8k FFT512 hop32,backtrack32ms; hard next onset pitch cap,80ms support; M2 rise1.2/flux.8; A3 CREPE.21/PENN.2 continuous80ms + energy; R1 as frozen75
stage1.fusion: union full-recipe notes, cluster onsets within40ms of cluster first (no transitive chaining); pick highest independent-source same-pitch frame support then neural fraction then strongest normalized attack, ties control-source then earlier; require source criterion and credible attack (rise>=1.1 OR flux>=.5); keep primary frozen winner note unless alternative source support is strictly higher; no-anchor weak alternates rejected; enforce80ms onset spacing, clip monophony

stage2.fixed: best complete stage1 output; baseline if no improvement
stage2.proposal_pool: stage1 notes + 80ms consecutive pYIN/neural rounded-pitch runs; model valid thresholds pYIN.05 voiced, CREPE.21 PENN.2; energy gated; anchor[-256,+32]ms nearest credible; same40ms first-anchor clusters
stage2.joint_decoding: note-level dynamic program over each onset cluster: silence or evidence-backed pitch; previous pitch state retained through silence; sum emission - onset cost - bounded pitch-jump penalty; no forced scale/chord/key, no beat quantization; multiple-source support required for new events; original note candidate allowed; no reference inputs
stage2.emission: per source maximum of model support fraction within first min320ms/event duration; source votes require >=64ms cumulative exact rounded pitch support; neural agreement fraction; audio attack capped at2; sum over3 sources /3
stage2.jump: min(abs(semitones)/12,2), penalized only at emitted notes, allowing true leaps; states include silence and all pool pitches

stage3.rule: only add absent notes with same-pitch support from both neural estimators in at least2 sources; corresponding audio attack present in2 sources within40ms; onset spacing/retained durations use profile minimum; no global confidence reduction; do not replace pitch of existing overlapping same-pitch note; preserve monophony

selection: highest formal F1 whole recipe; ties fewerFP; keep previous selected if no strictly higherF1; register profiles before any new score, no post-score expansion
delivery: all positive/negative scores; every reference gain/loss; selected bass+six-trackMID and MIDI-onlyWAV; per-edit source evidence and local original/stem clips; hash manifest; frozen commit then read-only independent verification; private GitHub code/compact records only
limits: no60–120, vocals ignored, no paid API/external upload/training, no new separation or weight download, no studio SDR/generalization claims; old default runner unchanged
